picks.reason: This is a price play more than a projection play: the Book's own no-vig chance on the under is 52.46%, already above the 51.22% break-even at -105, and the Bot barely moves it. The Bot projects Laurent Brossoit for 22.85 saves, modestly under 23.5, from a blended rate of 23.4 that the game script trims by 1.3% with LA expected to score 3 and LA's shot volume trims by 0.6%. His weighted history lands on the under 76.47% of the time, but that rests on 6.5 weighted games and 6 starts this season, so it is a hint more than proof. Where the Bot and the Book agree this closely, there is little the price looks to be missing. The desk bets 52.48%, an edge of 1.26 points, and that edge only cleared the shopped-price guard at another book's number, which is why it carries the practice stake.
picks.risk: The projection of 22.85 sits less than a save under 23.5, so a few extra LA shots in one period clears the line, and with only 6 starts this season his true workload is barely known.
